description: Use this when someone asks what was said on a company's earnings call or other investor call: guidance, answers to analysts, comments on a topic. Give it the call's id or 6ix.com link from get_company_earnings_calls or get_earnings_calendar, and optionally words to find. Returns the call's text with times, and speaker names where 6ix has them, one part at a time (ask for part 2 and on to read the rest), or the passages that mention the words, 8 at a time, closest matches first, with how many there are (pass nextCursor as cursor for more; part 2 and on narrows the search to that part).

call.description: The call's id or its 6ix.com link (6ix.com/event/…)

cursor.description: To read on: nextCursor from this tool's last answer, exactly as given, with the same other arguments

find.description: Only the passages that mention these words, e.g. "guidance" or "cash costs"

part.description: Which part of a long call to read (default 1); with find, part 2 and on searches only that part. The answer says how many parts there are

name: get_earnings_call_transcript

fiscalPeriod.description: Fiscal quarter the results call covers, e.g. Q2 2026

transcript.description: The call's text can be read with get_earnings_call_transcript

hasMore.description: More parts, or more passages with find, follow

matches.description: With find: how many passages mention the words (in the part searched)

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor to read on; null at the end

part.description: The part read, or the part searched with find (absent when find searched the whole call)

participants.description: With speakerSource matcher: people named for the call, without saying who said what

at.description: When the passage's paragraph starts in the replay (h:mm:ss); the quoted words may come later in it

excerpt.description: The paragraph is longer: this is the stretch around the words

part.description: The part holding the whole paragraph

speaker.description: Who the replay names as speaking; empty when no speaker is identified

speakerSource.description: feed: names come from the call's feed, matched to the replay by time; unverified: an automated timeline's names, not checked, so a passage may name the wrong person; matcher: an automated matcher's names exist but are not tied to words (see participants); none: no speaker timeline

speakers.description: Speakers the call feed names in the text

speakersCover.description: Seconds of the replay the feed's names cover; text outside says (speaker not identified)

version.description: Changes when the call's text changes

title: Read an earnings call
